Definition: an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach
BiblicalUsage: Ezrachite is a title, not a name on its own — it marks a man as a descendant of Zerach. Solomon's wisdom is measured against Ethan the Ezrahite in 1 Kings 4:31, and Solomon was wiser than them all. The same title stands in the headings of two psalms, over the songs of Heman and Ethan, though those headings carry no verse number of their own.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe it matters that wisdom had a measuring stick before Solomon; Ethan the Ezrahite was the wise man of his day, and Solomon surpassed him — which tells me God's wisdom is greater than the best wisdom of men.
